reference_validation.interpretation: Original whole-step 3% NRMSE gate fails at positions 2/3; retained. Small Q/K rounding changes are amplified by attention/softmax. CPU attention evaluated on identical GPU Q/K/V has NRMSE below 0.0002. Conditional-on-route check is diagnostic, not substituted for the failed original check.
